skill.name: social-content
skill.description: Create, adapt, and optimize social media content for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Supports content pillars, templates, calendars, repurposing, engagement routines, analytics, and ethical pattern analysis.
skill.summary: Create platform-specific social posts, calendars, and repurposing plans for major social networks.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All static external command and reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown templates and social media guidance. One semantic issue remains: the skill recommends large-scale social post collection with scraper tools without clear authorization or platform compliance guardrails.

remediation.issue: Large-scale social scraping guidance lacks authorization limits.
remediation.suggestion: Add guardrails to analyze only owned content or data collected with permission and in compliance with platform terms and privacy rules.

remediation.issue: Publishing capability is overstated in the skill introduction.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the skill drafts and plans content, and only publishes when the host environment provides an authorized scheduling integration.

semantic_findings.title: Large-Scale Social Platform Scraping Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs users to gather 500-1000+ posts from identified creators and names scraper tools including Apify and Phantom Buster. This can enable platform policy violations or collection of creator content beyond user-owned data if used without authorization.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited section explicitly recommends collecting posts at scale and lists automation tools. The intent is marketing analysis, but authorization and platform compliance limits are not stated.

content.value_statement: Many teams need posts, calendars, and repurposing plans that fit each platform. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code draft social content, adapt formats, and review performance patterns.
actual_capabilities: Creates platform-specific post ideas for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
Builds content pillar frameworks and weekly or monthly planning calendars.
Repurposes blog posts, podcasts, and videos into social formats.
Drafts hooks, threads, captions, carousel outlines, and short video scripts.
Provides engagement, scheduling, and analytics review checklists.
Helps extract successful content patterns and adapt voice guidelines.
limitations: It does not connect to social platforms or publish posts by itself.
Performance guidance is general and should be tested against current analytics.
Scraping or competitor analysis must follow platform terms and privacy rules.
It cannot verify factual claims without user-provided sources.

use_cases.title: Build Founder Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Turn lessons, opinions, and company updates into LinkedIn posts and X threads with clear hooks and calls to action.

use_cases.title: Plan a Multi-Platform Calendar
use_cases.description: Create a weekly or monthly calendar that maps themes, formats, platforms, and review metrics.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Long-Form Content
use_cases.description: Convert a blog post, podcast, webinar, or video into captions, threads, carousels, and short video ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Single Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one LinkedIn post about this topic: [topic]. Use a professional tone, a strong first line, and one engagement question.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Weekly Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a one-week social content calendar for [audience] on [platforms]. Include theme, format, hook, CTA, and success metric for each day.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose Source Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Turning one asset into many posts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Repurpose this [blog, podcast, or video summary] into one LinkedIn post, one X thread, one Instagram carousel outline, and one short video script.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Patterns and Voice
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced optimization using existing performance data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these past posts and metrics. Identify the strongest hooks, formats, CTAs, and voice patterns, then propose ten new post concepts.

output_examples.input: A founder wants to share a lesson from a difficult product launch.
output_examples.output: A story-led LinkedIn post outline with hook, setup, conflict, lesson, CTA, and three alternate first lines.

output_examples.input: A team has a blog post about improving customer onboarding.
output: LinkedIn carousel outline with ten slide themes.
X thread with a hook, five teaching tweets, and a recap.
Instagram caption with a concise CTA.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for a weekly posting plan for two platforms.
output_examples.output: A five-day plan with platform, theme, format, CTA, and review metric for each post.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, platform, offer, and desired voice before asking for drafts.
Supply source material and facts when posts include claims, numbers, or customer stories.
Review platform policies before using automation, scraping, or competitor analysis workflows.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to publish or schedule posts without an authorized platform tool.
Copying competitor posts instead of extracting general patterns and creating original content.
Using engagement bait, exaggerated claims, or unverified results to drive reach.

faq.question: Does this skill publish social posts?
faq.answer: No. It drafts and plans content unless the host environment provides an authorized publishing integration.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, with guidance for each platform.

faq.question: Can it create a content calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. It can build weekly and monthly calendars with themes, formats, CTAs, and metrics.

faq.question: Can it repurpose existing content?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a blog post, video summary, podcast notes, or transcript for better results.

faq.question: Does it guarantee viral content?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and tests, but performance depends on audience, timing, offer, and execution.

faq.question: Can it analyze competitor content?
faq.answer: It can structure ethical analysis of authorized or public data. Follow platform terms and privacy requirements.
